model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в коефициента на разреденост (sparsity ratio) на изхода от SDPA при праг 1e-3 за различни слоеве на модел. Заглавието на графиката е „Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3".

Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" и представлява номера на слоя. Скалата е линейна, с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Sparsity Ratio" и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0.0 до приблизително 0.8, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8).

Първата линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003", е в син цвят с пунктиран стил (тире-точка). Тя остава почти постоянна и много близо до нулата по цялата дължина на оста X, като започва от стойност около 0.02 при слой 0 и се задържа в диапазона 0.01–0.03 до слой 23, където достига приблизително 0.005.

Втората линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126", е в оранжев цвят с точков (dotted) стил. Тя започва от най-високата стойност сред трите линии — приблизително 0.85 при слой 0 — и рязко спада до около 0.35 при слой 2, след което продължава да намалява по-плавно, достигайки стойности около 0.05–0.07 при слоеве 10–15. В последните слоеве (около 20–23) се наблюдава леко покачване до приблизително 0.06.

Третата линия, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080", е в зелен цвят със стил тире-точка (dash-dot). Тя започва от стойност около 0.75 при слой 0 и също спада рязко, достигайки около 0.15 при слой 3 и около 0.08 при слой 5. След слой 7–8 линията се стабилизира близо до нулата и остава на стойности около 0.01–0.02 до слой 23.

Легендата е разположена в горната дясна част на графиката и съдържа описание на трите линии заедно с техните средни стойности.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output at a threshold of 1e-3, comparing three different conditions across network layers. The x-axis represents "Layer," scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Sparsity Ratio," scaled linearly from 0.0 to approximately 0.8, with tick intervals of 0.2. Three lines are plotted. The first, a blue dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," remains nearly flat and close to zero across all layers, starting at roughly 0.02 at layer 0 and staying at or near 0.01 throughout, ending near 0.0 at layer 23. The second, an orange dotted line labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," begins at approximately 0.85 at layer 0, drops steeply through the early layers to around 0.15 by layer 5, continues to decrease more gradually to roughly 0.03 by layer 10, then fluctuates slightly around 0.02–0.05 through the remaining layers, with a small uptick to approximately 0.06 near layer 23. The third, a green dash-dot line labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," starts at approximately 0.75 at layer 0, decreases sharply to around 0.10 by layer 5, continues declining to near 0.02 by layer 8, and then remains close to 0.0 for the remaining layers through layer 23.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers of a model, using a threshold of 1e-3, comparing three conditions: before gating, after gating, and after average gating. The x-axis represents "Layer," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Sparsity Ratio," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style, represents the sparsity ratio before the gate (average 0.003); it remains nearly flat and close to zero across all layers, starting at approximately 0.02 at layer 0 and staying near 0.01 throughout, ending near 0.0 at layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents the sparsity ratio after the gate (average 0.126); it begins at approximately 0.85 at layer 0, declines steeply through the first several layers to roughly 0.15 by layer 5, continues decreasing more gradually to approximately 0.03 around layer 10, and then remains near 0.02–0.05 for the remaining layers, with a slight uptick to approximately 0.05 at layer 23. The third line, shown in green with a dash-dot line style, represents the sparsity ratio after the average gate (average 0.080); it starts at approximately 0.75 at layer 0, drops sharply to about 0.45 at layer 1, continues declining to roughly 0.10 by layer 5, and then decreases further to near 0.0 by layer 10, remaining close to zero through layer 23.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm zeigt das Sparsity Ratio des SDPA-Outputs bei einem Schwellenwert von 1e-3 über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells hinweg, wobei drei verschiedene Messungen verglichen werden. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Abständen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Sparsity Ratio" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0.0 bis etwa 0.8, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Die erste Linie, dargestellt in Blau mit gestricheltem Linienstil (dash-dot) und ohne auffällige Marker, repräsentiert das „sparsity ratio before gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.003; sie verläuft nahezu konstant auf einem sehr niedrigen Niveau, beginnend bei etwa 0.02 bei Layer 0 und bleibt über alle Schichten hinweg nahe 0.0, mit einem leichten Anstieg auf etwa 0.02–0.03 im Bereich der Layer 10–15, bevor sie bei Layer 23 wieder auf nahe 0.0 abfällt. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt in Orange mit gepunktetem Linienstil, repräsentiert das „sparsity ratio after gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.126; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei etwa 0.85, fällt steil ab auf etwa 0.4 bei Layer 2 und weiter auf etwa 0.1 bei Layer 6, verläuft dann relativ flach mit Werten zwischen 0.02 und 0.06 bis Layer 23, wo sie bei etwa 0.05 endet. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt in Grün mit einem Strich-Punkt-Linienstil, repräsentiert das „sparsity ratio after average gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.080; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei etwa 0.75, fällt ebenfalls steil ab auf etwa 0.3 bei Layer 2 und weiter auf etwa 0.08 bei Layer 5, sinkt dann weiter auf nahe 0.0 ab etwa Layer 8 und bleibt bis Layer 23 auf diesem niedrigen Niveau nahe 0.0.
